title: 2008 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement: A shape is created by joining seven unit cubes, as shown. What is the ratio of the volume in cubic units to the surface area in square units?

solutions.text:
The shape uses \(7\) unit cubes, so its volume is \(7\) cubic units.

The center cube has no exposed faces. Each of the six outer cubes has \(5\) exposed faces, for a total surface area of \(6\cdot5=30\) square units.

The ratio of volume to surface area is \(7:30\).

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: The volume is just the number of unit cubes.
For surface area, each of the six outer cubes has \(5\) exposed faces.
